description.p: Tarot Canvas is a digital home for your personal tarot collection.

ul.li: Explore tarot decks and discover card meanings.
Perform tarot readings using your library of decks and spreads.
Create your own spreads and arrange tarot cards from any deck on a virtual canvas.
Add your own personal decks by following a simple tarot deck format.

screenshot.caption: Main view of a single card
Perform a tarot reading from a spread
A sandbox canvas of cards from multiple decks
View of your library of tarot decks
Take custom notes attached to cards

description.p: This version introduces tarot readings from your spreads.

ul.li: Read from a spread by drawing cards from any deck.
Take notes for a reading and store them in a journal.
Save any open Canvas as a tarot reading.
Introduced several new canvas background options, including a swirled animation and your own images.
Added shortcuts for switching pages in the Library View and Card View (Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, etc.).
Reworked the Welcome Screen to provide more options.

description.p: This version introduces tarot spreads as a main feature.

ul.li: Create your own custom tarot spreads and save them in a library.
Several well-known spreads are included out-of-the-box.
Added optional card snapping to the canvas for creating precise spreads.
Reworked the circle arrangement tool to produce arcs as well.
Improved performance of canvas motion by using GPU acceleration.

description.p: This version provides minor quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes.

ul.li: The icon for canvas tabs now show a colorful minimap.
Right-clicking a tab now opens a menu (for renaming a canvas).
Double-clicking on the canvas summons a random card.
Double-clicking the tab bar opens a new canvas tab.
Allow selection of checkerboard color in the canvas settings.
Fixed bug where tab names flicker briefly when first opened.
Fixed bug where the app would sometimes crash when exiting.

description.p: This version overhauls the tarot deck view in several ways:

ul.li: Allow selecting, copying and pasting multiple cards to a canvas.
Provide multiple views for a tarot deck.
Search for cards within a deck.
Fix dark mode / light mode toggle.
Update Flathub metadata.
Add esoterica to Library view.
Add keyboard shortcuts to settings.
Add settings for font size.
Add Marseille deck
Add keyboard shortcuts to switch tabs (Alt+1, Alt+2, etc)
Improve performance of deck view
Bump KDE runtime

description.p: Add keywords to card overview tab.
Overhauled esoterica tab (card meanings) and bundled a large dataset out-of-the-box.

ul.li: Fixed sluggish launch of Find Card panel.

description.p: Quality of life and UX improvements for notes:

ul.li: Added most recent notes to the card overview.
Reworked Notes tab to be more intuitive.
Added a Notes section to the library to show notes for all cards.
